name: apps/system-tools
description: Commands for looking after the machine: the file tools, the file-handler registry, and the localization commands.
residual: Split out of std/system on 2026-08-27. All three have fan-in zero -- nothing in the 768-module tree imports them -- and they export Commands.Context commands, which is what apps/ is for. They mattered out of proportion to their size: they were std's only path to Configuration and through it to the whole XML stack, so moving them took five modules out of the SDK payload.
